{{short description|American mathematician (born 1953)}}
'''Michael Steenstrup Vogelius''' (born 1953) is an [[Americans|American]] [[mathematician]].

==Education==
Vogelius completed his [[Doctor of Philosophy|Ph.D]]. at the [[University of Maryland]] College Park in 1980. His doctoral advisor was [[Ivo Babuška]]. His dissertation thesis was titled ''A Dimensional Reduction Approach to the Solution of Partial Differential Equations''.<ref name="nodak.edu">{{cite web|url=https://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=6195|title=Michael Vogelius –The Mathematics Genealogy Project|work=nodak.edu}}</ref>

==Career==
Vogelius has been a member of the faculty of the Mathematics Department at [[Rutgers University]] since 1989.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.math.rutgers.edu/~vogelius/|title=Homepage of Michael Vogelius|work=rutgers.edu}}</ref> Since 1997, he has supervised the doctoral dissertations of at least six students at the [[Rutgers University]].<ref name="nodak.edu"/> He has also worked as a Division Director at the [[National Science Foundation]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.nsf.gov/mobile/staff/staff_bio.jsp?lan=mvogeliu&org=DMS&from_org=|title=Michael Vogelius – National Science Foundation|work=nsf.gov}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.nsf.gov/staff/staff_bio.jsp?lan=mvogeliu|title=Michael Vogelius – NSF – National Science Foundation|work=nsf.gov}}</ref>

==Select bibliography ==
* ''Analysis of an enhanced approximate cloaking scheme for the conductivity problem.''
* ''Diffusion and Homogenization Limits with Separate Scales''
* ''Approximate Cloaking for the Full Wave Equation via Change of Variables.''
* ''Pointwise polarization tensor bounds, and applications to voltage perturbations caused by thin inhomogeneities.''
* ''An Elliptic Regularity Result for a Composite Medium with "Touching" Fibers of Circular Cross-Section.''<ref>{{cite web|url=https://dblp.uni-trier.de/pers/hd/v/Vogelius:Michael|title=dblp: Michael Vogelius|work=uni-trier.de}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://scholar.google.co.in/citations?user=IO4biYEAAAAJ&hl=en|title=Michael Vogelius – Google Scholar Citations|work=google.co.in}}</ref>
